description: B-1105 ordinary-client production gate. Remove only the sandbox copy of the duplicate top-level Mauler held mesh so the base:mauler public .pdweapon must supply its embedded held_hi.pdmesh. The boot extractor may verify the raw ROM-derived file before catalog construction, but every runtime model boundary must use the separately typed public source. Then prove the complete 13-slot authored material domain reaches one bounded gun-model load, first-person render, ordinary fire, and clean exit. Captures retain V-009's no-obstruction, placement, and material regression gate while preserving firing frames for effect review.

input_sequence.comment: Pause the virtual script until the ordinary Combat Simulator player is continuously spawned, live, controllable, and in walking mode; use one bounded canonical Skip only if the authored intro owns control.

input_sequence.name: ACTION_AIM_DOWN
input_sequence.comment: Aim the real player and Mauler toward ordinary nearby world collision after usable gameplay is proven.

input_sequence.name: ACTION_FIRE_PRIMARY
input_sequence.comment: Exercise the production Mauler fire path while the held source model is live.

input_sequence.name: ACTION_FIRE_PRIMARY
input_sequence.comment: Second ordinary shot gives the visual gate a separate settled firing witness.
Exit after cold nested-source conversion, stable held-model render, two fire edges, and all visual captures.
